g.text: GPIO numbers, NOT a physical header drawing. Use PJRC's official pinout for placement.
ROW0–4: selected row LOW, others INPUT
500 Hz, 8-bit PWM → LED driver gate input
Optional CAN1 TX / RX → 3.3 V transceiver
Optional MCP2515 CS / MOSI / MISO / SCK
Optional Wire SDA / SCL (unused by sketch)
Common signal and LED supply ground
All GPIO are 3.3 V only, NOT 5 V tolerant. USB Serial uses no GPIO 0/1.
Reference: https://www.pjrc.com/teensy/pinout.html (Teensy 4.1 front and back cards)
